hints.title: Time Conversion to Minutes
hints.text: Convert both login and logout strings into elapsed minute integers from the start of the day.

hints.title: Midnight Crossing Adjustment
hints.text: If logout occurs at a smaller minute value than login, add twenty-four hours in minutes to the logout time.

hints.title: Quarter-Hour Boundary Alignment
hints.text: Round the login time up to the next fifteen-minute boundary and round the logout time down to the previous fifteen-minute boundary.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfRounds(self, loginTime: str, logoutTime: str) -> int:
        h1, m1 = map(int, loginTime.split(':'))
        h2, m2 = map(int, logoutTime.split(':'))
        t1 = h1 * 60 + m1
        t2 = h2 * 60 + m2

        if t2 < t1:
            t2 += 24 * 60

        start = ((t1 + 14) // 15) * 15
        end = (t2 // 15) * 15

        if end < start:
            return 0
        return (end - start) // 15
```
